Name: PFM Upgraded Jars fix
Author: Icarusr
Description:
The mod has not been updated for a long time. The upgraded jar cannot be used to marinate fish seeds. The link in the comment area has also been 404. With the help of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9473360]VonLoewe[/url], I made this repair file, which can be used to marinate fish roe by covering the original file. It has been tested. The preparation formula of the Chinese translation may not be suitable for everyone because of my changes. If you want to experience the original formula, please use the overwrite mode.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5181]PFM在Stardew Valley Nexus升级了罐子 - Mods and community （nexusmods.com）[/url]

mod已经很久没有更新，升级的罐头瓶无法腌制鱼籽，评论区的链接也已经404。在[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9473360]VonLoewe[/url]的帮助下我制作了这个修复文件，覆盖原本的文件即可腌制鱼籽，已经过测试。中文翻译的制作配方因为经过我的改动，可能不适合所有人，如果想要体验原版配方，请使用覆盖模式。

Downloads.Description:
原版未改动制作配方，直接覆盖到同名文件。
The original version does not change the formulation and directly overwrites the file with the same name.
